label: ULTIMATE SPELLS GUIDE - [Updated] BG3 Spells Tier List - Level 5

items.verdict: about 100 burst damage on a guaranteed crit; ONLY VIA HEXBLADE WARLOCK OR BARD MAGICAL SECRETS
high C; recastable double-dip damage, but half the relevant enemies are poison immune
only worth it doubled up on wet grouped enemies; best AoE burst for hexblade warlocks
an all-day summon as strong as an extra party member; all eight modes viable
pre-combat disease can end a fight instantly, but Bestow Curse is far cheaper
non-concentration AoE damage plus prone; a free domain spell for Tempest and Light clerics
one unreliable temporary ally for a level 5 slot; AoE control is better
a cleric's only AoE nuke, but weaker than an upcast Fireball
duplicated by cheaper Freedom of Movement and Remove Curse; petrification never happens
paralysis is devastating but costs a level 5 slot and caps at two targets
22 damage a turn with no double-dip; barely beats level 2 Cloud of Daggers
reactive healing that Mass Healing Word does with a bonus action and level 3 slot
Hold Monster locks the same creatures more reliably; many of these targets are immune
party-wide Disguise Self is pointless when only one character can hold a conversation
repeatable no-weight-limit throw for repositioning; BUGGED, a first-cast save cancels concentration
fiddly targeting spawns walls with holes and 30 HP pillars die in one hit

items.item: Curriculum of Strategy: Artistry of War
items.verdict: 72 unmissable force damage in six instances; WIZARD-ONLY SECRET SPELL, once per short rest
BUGGED fixed DC 18 con save plus necrotic resistance; WIZARD-ONLY SECRET SPELL, once per long rest

unassigned.why: Dispel Evil and Good is discussed at length and called laughably bad (a buggier, pricier Protection from Evil and Good) but is never given a letter; at 37:56 he only says it or Seeming is the worst spell in the game, and the D tier that follows lands on Seeming
